name: Thermometer
description: Provides a thermometer block widget for visualizing fundraising progress toward a goal.
project_description:
The thermometer module provides a block to allow you to create a simple thermometer widget, useful for fundraising goals, without relying on an external third-party service, etc. It also uses CSS and Javascript, and not any Flash, etc. 

 Enable the module. Go to the blocks page and configure the "Thermometer" block. Here you will set the target and current values of your thermometer, to show its progress. Place it where you want to see it!

 The output is themeable, but beware that the JavaScript depends on the markup to a certain extent.
